crossRefs.note: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only: and their brothers the sons of Kish took them as wives.

people.name: Eleazar
people.line: Son of Mahli, had no sons, only daughters

people.name: Mahli
people.line: Son of Merari, grandson of Levi.

translations.web: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
translations.bsb: From Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
translations.kjv: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.
translations.asv: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
